title: Balada o pilotovi
description: Emil Malik, a former RAF captain returns home to his family in 1945 hoping for a happy life after surviving the horrors of war piloting combat aircrafts. He will clash against the reality of those he left behind under the overseeing eye of communism within the Iron Curtain.

title: Bachna O Haseeno
description: 💖 Betrayed in love, chosen by destiny - can he handle his billionaire life? 🔥 Fr

title: O quê! Meu husky é o rei lobo!?
description: Shellie, uma caçadora de coelhos pobre e alegre, caça na propriedade todos os dias para pagar os remédios da avó. Um dia, ela resgata um lobo ferido e, achando ser um husky de raça duvidosa, o batiza de Jet. Com um simples carinho na cabeça, ela o doma e o transforma em seu cão de caça. A verdadeira identidade de Jet é Hoyer, o último rei lobo, cujo nome aterroriza a todos. Gravemente ferido, ele planejava devorar essa garota imprudente de uma vez, mas descobre que ficar ao lado de Shellie restaura sua magia. Para sobreviver, o orgulhoso rei lobo engole o orgulho e se finge de cachorro, às vezes assumindo a forma de um homem incrivelmente atraente de abdômen trincado. Aonde quer que Shellie vá, seja para a escola ou para o trabalho, ela o leva junto. Garotas manipuladoras e veteranos ricos tentando conquistá-la são sumariamente barrados pela atitude dominadora de Hoyer. Aos poucos, ele perde a vontade de ir embora. Sua mente se enche de pensamentos como: Por que ela não coçou minha barriga hoje? e Será que o cara que mandou a carta de amor para ela quer morrer? Até que uma misteriosa organização de caçadores lança um ataque surpresa em massa. Para proteger Shellie, Hoyer assume sua forma humana, revelando completamente o disfarce. Chocada, mas firme, o forte instinto protetor de Shellie vem à tona, despertando uma antiga linhagem de caçadora. Ela joga o arquivilão no chão e o enche de pancada. Com a crise resolvida, o rei lobo, que deveria estar reconstruindo seu clã, não dá a mínima para os problemas do mundo, preferindo seguir Shellie o dia todo implorando por abraços.

title: Xuxa, O Documentário
description: The life and times of Xuxa, the Brazilian TV personality who rose to international fame in the 1990s.

title: Giannis Kastritsis: O anthropos kai o iskios tou
O zivej vode
description: Adaptation of the fairy-tale by the Grimm Brothers. The three sons of a king set out on a quest to find the magical "Water of Life" to save their father.

title: O Marido Desesperado
description: Li Wei foi um empresário bem-sucedido, mas após ir à falência, ele se tornou um limpador de janelas. Um dia, enquanto trabalhava, ele acidentalmente testemunhou um homem e uma mulher tendo um caso. A faixa de cabelo com orelhas de coelho da mulher e a pequena marca de flor vermelha fizeram-no suspeitar de infidelidade por parte de sua esposa. Quando voltou para casa, descobriu a mesma marca em sua esposa, Lin Xiaoya, o que aprofundou suas dúvidas. A partir daí, Li Wei plantou a semente da desconfiança em seu coração e começou a investigar sua esposa. Através de uma série de eventos, Li Wei finalmente descobriu a verdade...

title: Priya O Priya
description: Two rich brothers have a crush on their driver's daughter. Who will end up winning the girl's heart?

title: Laj o lajbazi
description: Pooneh, played by Sara Khoeiniha, and Farhad, played by Amir Jafari, have been separated for about three years after 15 years of living together. Pooneh's acquaintance with a young man becomes an incentive for Farhad to oust his love rival.

title: Tú o nadie
description: A young woman gets involved in a feud between two brothers.

title: O xypolytos pringips
description: Run out of options and in desperate need of cash, a down-and-out young man accepts his rich hotelier friend's preposterous proposal to impersonate an exotic Arab Prince. But what does the bride-to-be has to say about this scandalous farce?

title: O Marido Disfarçado
description: Su Nuanyan, CEO do Grupo Su, é abandonada por seu noivo após ser traída. Em um momento de fúria, ela se casa com Qi Sili. No entanto, devido ao seu destino, Qi Sili precisa fingir ser um tolo por nove anos. Depois de se tornar marido de Su Nuanyan, ele a apoia silenciosamente nos bastidores, ajudando-a a evitar ser alvo de humilhações, enquanto sua verdadeira identidade quase é descoberta por Su Nuanyan várias vezes.

title: O Filho Perdido de Zeus: O Retorno Triunfal
description: Hércules, filho de Zeus e Hera, desaparece ainda criança, e um seguidor invejoso o troca por Ícaro, um mortal. Dezoito anos depois, ele vai ao Olimpo para entrar para os Guardiões do Olimpo e salvar sua amada, superando Ícaro de longe. Sem saber quem ele realmente é, a família de Zeus, manipulada por Ícaro, o humilha e o exila. Quando a verdade é revelada, a família de Zeus implora desesperadamente por seu perdão, enquanto Ícaro trama vingança ao lado de Hades.

title: Lakis o glykoulis
description: Lakis is a hard-working and innocent married man, who hasn't finished high-school because he became a father at a very young age. His father dies and his will determines that, if Lakis is able to finish high school and get into a university, half of his fortune will belong to Lakis and the other half to his already rich brother.

title: O Garoto que o Quarterback Usou na Cama
description: Artur Mendes namorou escondido com o Quarterback Caio Rocha por seis meses. Caio nunca assumiu, preferindo fingir ser o casal perfeito com Daniela Mendes, irmã de Artur. Uma foto íntima de Artur vazou pelo campus após Daniela roubá-la do celular de Caio, que mandou Artur ficar quieto e continuou a usá-lo. O capitão do hóquei, Felipe Nogueira, abriu o Instagram na frente de todos: Quer sair comigo? Me segue primeiro. No dia seguinte, ele andou de mãos dadas com Artur no corredor, com os dedos entrelaçados para todo mundo ver. Daniela fingiu uma alergia a nozes para incriminar Artur, e ele enfiou a cabeça dela em uma fonte. Caio perdeu o jogo e gritou com Daniela na lateral do campo, destruindo sua imagem de garoto de ouro. Felipe venceu, olhou para a câmera e disse: Nosso goleiro segurou dois períodos sozinho. Não queria mais que ele carregasse isso sozinho. Todos entenderam.

title: O Grande Xerife
description: Inácio Pororoca is responsible for the local mail in an old west town. One day there comes bandit João Bigode, who kills the sheriff and puts Inácio on his place, just for fun. But Inácio takes his post seriously, and soon the bandits realize they've made a mistake.

title: Zulm-O-Sitam
description: Superintendent of Police Arun is a hardworking, honest and diligent police officer in Bombay. He has been assigned to lead the detail in charge of the state's Chief Minister's protection. Things do not go as planned, and the Chief Minister is killed. The police find evidence linking Arun with this killing, and have him arrested and imprisoned. Arun loudly claims he in innocent, but if he is innocent, who actually was involved in this killing?

title: Komediya o Lisistrate
description: Lysistrata led the women of ancient Greece in forcing men to stop the war, that was devastating the land. Lysistrata declared to women: "We must refrain from male altogether - till the men come to terms of peace".

title: O Bem-Amado
description: Sucupira's mayor, a corrupt politician full of tricks, has the inauguration of the local cemetery as his administration's priority, but is met with opposition led by the police chief and a newspaper journalist, in a deathless city.

title: Capo o héroe
description: Javier renace en familia rica, pero un sistema lo obliga a estudiar. Gana en matemáticas, salva vidas y crea el reactor Ark. Entre luchas de poder y matrimonios forzados, ayuda a otros y lleva a Gran Aurora a ser la primera potencia mundial.

title: O Caçador Supremo
description: Ele salvou o império. Depois, desapareceu. Por oito anos, Rael Montenegro viveu como andarilho, escondendo o nome que o mundo reverenciava — para proteger a família do mestre que morreu por ele. Mas a pobreza aperta, os inimigos cercam, e o Dragão Abissal volta. Na Seleção dos Caçadores Reais, Rael entra na arena como ninguém — e sai como uma lenda. Só que quanto mais ele tenta se esconder, mais a verdade vem à tona. E quando vier, vai custar tudo que ama.

title: Aranyak O Mudrarahasya
description: Aranyak a young detective comes to Kolkata with his assistant Shaumya to solve the mystery of a stolen numismatic coin after the murder of its owner Mr. Debayan. He adopts unique methods and style to solve the mystery.

title: O Sobrinho Dele é o Meu Pecado
description: Melanie Thorne é advogada de sucesso, divide escritório com o marido há dez anos e venceu o centésimo caso. George Dearborn volta do exterior para ser nomeado herdeiro da Dearborn Pharmaceuticals; é sobrinho do marido de Melanie. Quando se conhecem, a faísca é imediata e surge um amor intenso. Mas o universo, as famílias e a sociedade se voltam contra eles. Cederão às pressões ou ousarão acreditar que o mundo pertence a eles?

title: O Pai do Meu Filho É o Arquimago
description: Cinco anos depois de uma noite que mudou seu destino, a Rainha dos Lobos está prestes a perder a alcateia. Sua única esperança é encontrar o pai de seu filho. Quando finalmente consegue encontrá-lo, ela descobre que o homem é, na verdade, o poderoso Arquimago, justamente quem pode salvar ela e toda a alcateia.

title: O Segredo do Meu Marido: O Protetor
description: Um lendário comandante de guerra, vivendo disfarçado como mecânico, é forçado a voltar ao mundo do poder quando conhece uma CEO cujo império está desmoronando devido a uma armação cuidadosamente planejada. Juntos, eles iniciam uma retomada de alto risco, movida por amor, vingança e identidades secretas.

title: O Alfa Predestinado
description: Aos sete anos, Luan Moura desaparece para salvar a mãe lobisomem ferida, Helena Moura, após um acordo com o avô, Antônio Moura. Vinte anos depois, trabalhando como faxineiro e com amnésia, sua namorada Mariana Costa rouba sua pesquisa e o humilha com o herdeiro de sangue puro Júlio Ferraz. Helena, agora Alfa Suprema, chega para destruí-los, mas Antônio impede o reencontro. Sequestrado pelo renegado Mauro Viana, Luan vê Helena quase morrer por ele. Sua dor desperta o poder de nível Progenitor; ele mata Mauro, reencontra a mãe e ascende como Alfa Supremo.

title: O Piloto Fantasma
description: Após salvar em segredo uma base da Marinha, Matheus Carvalho, faxineiro e filho de um piloto desonrado, entra para a Forja Celeste, a elite da aviação militar. Enquanto enfrenta rivais e prova ser um piloto excepcional, Matheus descobre uma conspiração sobre a morte do pai e um poderoso senador disposto a esconder a verdade.

title: WITTY! Vhong at Jhong, sinubukan ang mga tanong sa Miss Q&A
description:
Weekend na, mga accla, kaya come out na sa lungga. Huwag puro "seen" sa GC kapag may nag-invite sa party-party lalo na't Pride Month celebration today. Join sa occasion ang "It's Showtime" family at ang mga weekly finalists ng "Miss Q and A."

From their daily round panalo, nagharap-harap sa panibagong talakan ang limang kandidata this Sabado—Shanaya De Guzman, Lixa Labbuanan, Lucky Robles Collins, Mama Mama, at Andrea Lim.

Na-challenge ang brain cells ng mga 'accla' sa Tumpak Ganern round, partikular na sa tanong tungkol sa pangalan ng isang senador. Pagkatapos ng Round 1, naligwak si Lixa, at ang apat naman ay umabante sa Wit Lang kung saan bumawi sila at pinalakpakan.

Nagtuloy-tuloy ang 'chukchakan' sa final round kung saan sina Mama Mama at Andrea ang naglaban. Iisang tanong lang ang ibinato sa kanila: "Anong materyal na bagay ang ireregalo mo sa nanay mong pagod?" "Ointment" ang sagot ni Mama Mama, at "bulaklak" naman para kay Andrea.

Nakisaya sa 'Laro Laro Pick' game arena ang mga residente ng Caloocan para subukan ang kanilang kapalaran! 'Napuruhan' si Teddy Corpuz sa aktingan. Paano ba naman, ang mga punchline, parang personalan. Kinarir naman ni Ogie Alcasid ang eksena bilang 'witch' na inakit si Brent Manalo. Kung may Best Actor sa araw na 'to, si Chief of OPM na 'yun, panigurado!

Dahil walang naka-survive sa lahat ng games, bumunot ng isang maswerteng eliminated player. At 'yun ay si Jomar! Para sa pamilya, si Jomar, hindi na sumugal pa at tinanggap na ang P25,000 offer sa Li-Pot.

title: Daddy U Misspelled Father
description: Trey can't fathom the importance of fatherhood, at least not until he's faced with an imminent eleven-year prison sentence. Jameelah, the mother of their three-year-old son, must suddenly deal with the immense struggles of being a single parent now that Trey is locked up. And at the same time, their young boy, Kiddo, is forced to deal with the emotional baggage that comes with his father's prolonged absence. Over time, Kiddo matures. He learns to see the world in his own light, and he ultimately decides he doesn't want anything to do with his incarcerated father. But upon his release from prison, Trey is a new man. He is brutally determined to prove his worth to his son. Unfortunately, gaining Kiddo's trust back will be one of the hardest things Trey has ever done.

title: Dai Sentai Goggle-V
description: The Dark Science Empire Desdark launches its scheme for world conquest from their Destopia Castle in Germany. Dr. Hideki Hongo, founder of the Future Science Laboratory, is saved from one of their attacks by world class explorer Kenichi Akama. Using his Computer Boys and Girls, Hongo recruits five people, including Kenichi, to form the Dai Sentai Goggle-V (Goggle 5), the only force capable of stopping Desdark.

title: Juan y Vanesa
description: When Juan, a 35-year-old truck driver learns he has a daughter, he decides to become responsible. He quits alcohol and takes one last chance at his job, to deliver various goods to Mexico City. At a gas station, Vanesa, a Mexican Lolita with pink-dyed hair convinces Juan to let her go with him. A rebellious teenager and a broken man start a journey where they confront each other and their own demons only to realize that this strange encounter can awake something unexpected and beautiful in them.

title: Tú, yo y mi avatar
description: A man or woman dates three avatars acting in behalf of his or her suitors before meeting them in person and deciding who he or she would date.

title: Las viciosas y la menor
description: A young woman, in love with a peasant, tries her fortune as a model in the capital, where she is seduced by lesbians.

title: Celedonio y yo somos así
description: Celedonio y yo somos así

title: La CEO y el Repartidor
description: Arturo Iglesias, un simple repartidor, jamás creyó que acabaría casado con una hermosa CEO. ¡Y encima, ella se lo pidió! Tras su último pedido, solo podía pensar: "¡Por fin, este holgazán cambió su suerte!"

title: El alazán y el rosillo
description: Rosendo vuelve a su pueblo natal, San Fernando, pero un antiguo amigo suyo ha estafado por toda la región. El decide frenar ese pillaje y se propone con Rosillo, un pura sangre, ganar varias carreras para devolver a los campesinos sus propiedades.

title: [Doblado]Entre Rayos y Traiciones
description: Mas entre antigas maldições e segredos dos deuses, será que ela conseguirá mudar o destino - ou acabará presa no mesmo jogo de amor e vingança?,Traición y poder en el Olimpo. Selene elige a Alejandro, desatando la furia de Escirón y las mentiras de Dafne. Entre maldiciones de Cerbero y sed de venganza, los dioses luchan por el trono y el verdadero amor.

title: [doblado]Entre amigos y amores
description: Durante siete años, Summer y Shawn compartieron un amor silencioso. Tras un beso impulsivo, él la rechazó por miedo al compromiso. Desilusionada, Summer acepta el cortejo de Julian, otro amigo de la infancia, pese a los celos de Shawn. Pero justo cuando su relación se afianza, Julian desaparece misteriosamente...

title: Su Humilde y Dura Esposa
description: Todos en la ciudad le temían, pero se casó con una mujer del campo que resultó saber de medicina, lucha, e incluso era dueña de parte de una gran empresa. El CEO le teme a su esposa, "¡Lo siento, no volveré a husmear en tus identidades secretas otra vez!"

title: Miles and Lies
description: It tells the story of Lu who loves to pretend that she has a perfect life but the reality is that she can't even pay her share of the bar that she opened with her two best friends so she works there as a bartender.

title: Papá mafioso y despiadado
description: El día que Ellie logra un embarazo mediante FIV, descubre que su prometido y su mejor amiga están teniendo una aventura. Devastada, decide criar a su hijo sola. Su doctora revela que hubo un error en el banco de esperma: lleva en su vientre al hijo del jefe de la mafia. Ellie se ve arrastrada involuntariamente a una guerra de sucesión dentro de la mafia. Para proteger a su bebé nonato, acepta un matrimonio por contrato con el jefe de la mafia. Ni ella ni él imaginaron que esto los llevaría al verdadero amor.

title: [Doblado]Tócala y arde
description: El día de mi compromiso, mi madre y yo estábamos en el carro esperando al chofer cuando la secretaria de mi prometido me mandó de pronto un video. En él, tenía a una loba de mediana edad tomada del cabello y le daba bofetada tras bofetada. "¡Selena, maldita interesada! ¿De verdad creíste que fingir ser una socialité y comprometerte con el Alfa Damián permitiría que tu madre se metiera a robar en su casa?" Otra bofetada cayó. El rostro de la mujer ya estaba horriblemente hinchado. "Típico de gente corriente. Siempre tomando lo ajeno. Como secretaria de Damián, me encargo de esta ladrona inmunda por él". Bajé lentamente el celular. A mi lado, mi madre se acomodaba el collar frente a su espejo compacto. Al notar que la miraba, sonrió y me acarició la mano. "La Manada Corona de Espinas puede ser un desastre en los negocios, cariño, pero Damián es guapísimo. Cuando la alianza sea oficial, tu padre y yo podremos arreglarlo todo". Frunciendo el ceño, reproduje el video otra vez. Los pómulos finos. El peinado impecable. Y el lunar en la oreja. Dios mío. ¡Era mi futura suegra, la señora Beltrán! Llamé de inmediato. "Vanessa, ¿tienes idea de lo idiota que eres? ¡Esa es la madre de Damián!" Ella soltó una risa cruel. "Ay, por favor. Damián ya me contó todo sobre ti. Una don nadie con la que su padre lo obligó a casarse. Ni siquiera le importas, así que ¿por qué le importaría tu familia?"

title: El cura y el veneno
description:
SINOPSIS El Cura y el Veneno

Una fiesta lujosa en la Embajada Francesa de Madrid se convierte en el escenario de un crimen mortal. Las circunstancias misteriosas que rodean la muerte de un hombre influyente acaban convirtiendo a algunos de los propios invitados en sospechosos de asesinato. El crimen que, a primera vista, parece ser resuelto, empieza a tomar un movimiento serpentino que, poco a poco, ira destapando secretos guardados y deseos ocultos, poniendo de relieve las manifestaciones del veneno interior que todos llevamos dentro.

Felipe, un modesto cura y profesor de un colegio religioso, se ve implicado de forma inesperada en tales acontecimientos en los que el poder manda y el engaño impregna lo cotidiano.

Forzado a iniciar una investigación al margen de la ley, Felipe se hunde en un mundo oscuro donde se topara, cara a cara, con sus propios demonios que han regresado de un turbio pasado.

Este largometraje actual, con reminiscencias propias del clasico cine negro, posee una estética fuertemente expresiva y una estilización visual impactante que crean una atmósfera difusa, oscura, donde las apariencias engañan y la desconfianza reina.

Los espectadores se veran sumergidos en un mundo de misterio y una maraña de intriga y conflicto hasta llegar a la resolucion menos esperada.



 SYNOPSIS The Priest and the Poison

A glamorous reception at the French Embassy in Madrid becomes the scene of a deadly crime. The mysterious circumstances surrounding the death of an influential man of the French elite transform some of the guests into murder suspects. The crime, which at first glance seems so easily solved, takes on a serpentine movement that, little by little, uncovers well-kept secrets and hidden desires, the manifestations of a personal poison that we all carry within.

Felipe, an unassuming priest and teacher at a religious school for boys, finds himself caught up in a series of murders of political intrigue. Forced to begin an independent investigation outside the law, Felipe finds himself so immersed in this world of death and mistrust, that he is thrown face to face with his own dark past, from which he had tried so hard to escape.

This film resurrects the essence of classic film noir in a modern day context. With a strongly expressive and impacting aesthetic, this film creates an atmosphere of uncertainty, where appearances deceive and distrust reigns.

title: Nowhere to Run
description: The world is breaking down after a meteor shower which has impacted a large portion of the Western Hemisphere. In the Pacific Northwest, eight-year-old Erica's life is uprooted when she returns home from school to find herself running to stay alive. Erica has to run, gain new skills, and cooperate with those who are still among the living. She has no choice but to interact with a wide variety of characters from every walk of life and background. She hangs out a lot at the dance studio in her building... Louise decides to offer an hour of her time to strangers on the street. "An hour of myself", to do whatever they want to do. But one hour precisely, that's it. This leads to many different situations, some funny, some sexy, some sad. Louise talks to someone who later turns out to have been an undercover reporter. The reporter anticipates a bad end for Louise...

title: Au bon beurre
description: Léon Lécuyer, an idealistic history student, manages to escape from the camp where he was imprisoned and comes back to Paris. He hides in his mother's apartment when the Germans, informed by an anonymous letter, storm their block. He runs away once more and leaves for Lyon. Wishing to serve his country, Léon decides to kill Pierre Laval. But he does so badly that he is arrested and condemned to ten years in prison. Meanwhile in Paris, Charles-Hubert and Julie Poissonnard, the owners of the dairy shop "Au Bon Beurre", where Léon's mother shops, thrive by speculating on people's misery, by getting supplies on the black market, by selling goods ten times what they are worth, while blatantly supporting the policies of Maréchal Pétain. But when Charles-Hubert senses the wind turning, he changes attitudes. He saves a Jew and even "organizes" the Resistance in his neighborhood. After the war, the Poissonards, richer than ever, have gained a new respectability. As for Léon, now a history teacher at Lycée Jean-Baptiste Say, he is transferred against his will for ... giving bad grades to Henri, Poissonard's son.

title: Soufflé au Chocolat

title: L'oeil au beurre noir
description: This is an intelligent and sarcastic movie about daily racism. Our heroes are the painter Denise Santrose and Rachid, a black and an Algerian, who seek an apartment in Paris, France. Both meet Virginie, who'd be willing to help them to the vacant apartment of her stepfather, but he'd rather rent to some low-lifes than to to a black or an Algerian.

title: A secret experience of a delicious sex
A Criança Sortuda: De Abandonada a Estimada
description: Em 1978, na pacífica vila de Xingfu, Sun Pandi dá à luz uma menina, apenas para descobrir que nunca poderá ter mais filhos. Cheia de ressentimento em relação à sua filha recém-nascida, ela e seu marido decidem abandonar a menina nas montanhas, planejando adotar um menino em vez disso. No entanto, um milagre ocorre quando um espírito da sorte, Xiao Fubao, reencarna no corpo da menina abandonada. O bebê é logo encontrado por Zhang Xiulian, cunhada de Sun Pandi, que a leva para casa. Apesar da rejeição inicial, com o apoio obstinado de sua avó Wang Guiying, Xiao Fubao é adotada pela família Zhao, marcando o início de uma nova e afortunada vida para ela.

title: Minha Cicatriz, A Dívida Dele A Pagar
description: Rachel e Ethan ficaram presos em uma zona de guerra. Ao tentar salvar Ethan, Rachel acabou ficando com uma cicatriz desfigurante no rosto. Eles se apaixonaram e se casaram, mas havia apenas uma vaga de evacuação. Rachel a cedeu ao ferido Ethan, que prometeu voltar para buscá-la — sem saber que, mais tarde, Rachel descobriria que estava grávida.Seis anos depois, Rachel retorna ao país para salvar sua filha, Sophie, apenas para descobrir que Ethan havia se casado com a filha da diretora do hospital e formado uma nova família após seu retorno. Para proteger sua reputação e status, Ethan chegou até a difamar Rachel e Sophie.Nesse momento crucial, o pai há muito perdido de Rachel reaparece e revela que ela é, na verdade, a filha do presidente do Harrington Medical Group. No final, o médico inescrupuloso perde tudo e paga pelas próprias ações, enquanto Rachel passa a viver uma vida feliz ao lado de sua filha.

title: Miracle in a Box: A Piano Reborn
description: The restoration of a Steinway becomes a lyrical meditation on following the heart's true passion in this beautifully crafted documentary. A wonderful Bay Area tale, the film traces the path of a 1927 grand piano owned by a music teacher who bequeathed her treasure to her alma mater, UC Berkeley, with the stipulation that the university ultimately reward it to "a worthy student of piano." Before it can be given away, however, it must be restored, and here the essence of the story unfolds, as Korty follows the piano's rebirth under the masterful care of Oakland's venerable Callahan Piano Service.

title: Namorado Compartilhado
description:
No dia do casamento, o noivo da Megan, Mark, desaparece sem deixar vestígios. Após quatro anos de investigação, a polícia ainda não encontrou nenhuma pista sequer.
Consumida por uma obsessão implacável, Megan é levada por sua melhor amiga, Jennifer, a uma loja clandestina secreta que vende os chamados robôs de companhia hiper-realistas de 'namorado compartilhado'.
Ela fica horrorizada ao descobrir que o 'Robô Nº 07' é ninguém menos que Mark, desaparecido há quatro anos. Ele é mantido subjugado com drogas e choques elétricos, disfarçado de mercadoria para ser explorado com fins lucrativos. Para salvar seu amado, Megan engole a humilhação e finge obediência, reunindo provas secretamente. Passo a passo, ela descobre a chocante verdade: sua melhor amiga, movida pelo ódio nascido de um amor desprezado, foi quem 'doou' Mark para o dono da loja.
No confronto final, Megan colabora de dentro com a polícia para invadir e desmantelar a operação ilegal. Os dois se apoiam durante as longas sequelas do trauma, avançando firmemente rumo à cura e a um novo começo.

title: Guns N' Roses: Live in New York

'Live In New York' concert film was newly transferred from 35mm film prints to 4K UHD. title: O Casarão
description: An old house withers away at the heart of a village ripped in half by a road where cars no longer stop. During the dictatorship, this building was the most progressive Catholic seminary in Portugal. António, the front door neighbor, was brought up and raised a family in its shadow. Ever since the Dominican priests left, he has been its most faithful caretaker - keeper of ghosts, memories, and hallways now emptied of life. Abandoned for years, the town's former epicenter now hopes for a new life.

title: O Último Trago
description: The living call for revenge. The dead minerals and vegetables demand revenge. It is the hour of general protest. It's time for the destroying flights. It's time for the barricades, the shootings. Famines, desires, cravings, lost dreams, miseries of all countries, unite.

title: La viuda y su multimillonario
description: Tras 18 años de sacrificios, Clara es humillada y despojada de todo por Ricardo. Para levantarse, acepta un matrimonio por contrato de un año con el magnate Alejandro Beltrán. Mientras reconstruye su carrera y desenmascara el fraude de su ex y de Viviana, el frío pacto se convierte en amor real. Clara no solo recuperará su vida, sino que conquistará una segunda oportunidad bajo sus propias reglas.

title: Bebés Adorables y Padre Astuto
description:
Tras 10 años de amor infantil, él se casa con otra. Cuando la drogan, el poderoso Sr. Castro la rescata. Cinco años después, ella regresa con gemelos.
Aunque intenta esconderse, él la atrapa: "Juré que jamás te soltaría si te encontraba".

title: Revelar, alzar y reinar
description: ¡La primera cosa que hizo Cecilia Jiménez al terminar sus estudios fue romper con su novio Andrés Platero! Ella tenía mucho éxito en sus estudios con la ayuda de su novio y obtenía un sueldo de millones de dólares al año, pero rompió despiadadamente con él con el pretexto de que ya no estaban en el mismo nivel y que Andrés ya no era lo suficientemente bueno para ella.

title: ALAKADA GEN Z
description:
*ALAKADA GEN-Z; THE BEGINNING OF A NEW ERA.*

Here is the full movie *"Alakada: Gen-Z,"* the newest chapter in the beloved Alakada franchise. 

This new installment focuses on a younger generation, exploring themes of social media influence, identity, lifestyle trends, and the pressures of digital fame. It’s a hilarious and dramatic look at growing up in a hyper-connected world, blending the classic comedy of the franchise with fresh, contemporary stories.

*⭐ FEATURING A NEW WAVE OF TALENT:*

title: Ab heute erwachsen
description: The saga of Stefan (David C. Bunners), an 18-year-old construction worker who struggles to make it on his own is the theme that winds its way through this look at growing up. There are surprises in store for the young lad once he manages to move into his own apartment (he had a hard time telling his mother he was moving out). His landlord exploits his good nature to get him to do work around the house and to do favors for his friends too. Stefan's relationship with his mother is already strained after he moved out, and when she discovers how he is being used she really loses it. In an attempt to apologize, she gives Stefan her apartment to watch while she is away for awhile. He opportunistically decides to bring his new girlfriend home overnight, with comic and unforeseen consequences to his relationship with her and his mother.

title: The Ad and the Ego
description: Intercutting thousands of contemporary and classic television commercials with insights by Stuart Ewen, Jean Kilbourne, Sut JhalIy and others, this film scrutinizes late 20th century American society and its prime inhabitant, Consumer Man. You will never look at an ad the same way again after viewing what critics are calling "the first comprehensive documentary on the cultural impact of advertising in America".

title: Seninle Bir An
description: Avery Yale ile hızlı bir evlilik yapan Blake Lander, Avery'nin para avcısı olduğunu yanlış düşünerek zengin bir CEO kimliğini saklar. Zor bir hayatla mücadele eden Avery, iş yerinde zorbalık ve bir zamanlar güvendiği ailesi tarafından ihanete uğrar. Neyse ki, Blake her zaman onu korur ve aralarında derin bir bağ oluşur, yavaş yavaş aşık olurlar. Ancak Blake'in gerçek kimliği ortaya çıktığında, bir yanlış anlama ilişkilerinde bir çatlak yaratır ve bu ancak gerçeğin ortaya çıkmasıyla iyileşebilir. Onu kendine ait kılmaya kararlı olan Blake, evlenme teklif eder ve birlikte hayatlarının yeni bir bölümüne başlarlar.

title: What Happened at 22
description: Louise Lloyd comes to New York to obtain a position and applies to the Hollister Employment Agency, which caters to high class trade, but which is run by a crook and forger named Wilson, with a Mr. Hollister as figurehead, who meets the people and sends applicants. Wilson falls in love with Louise, but she does not reciprocate. Wilson passes a forged check and decides to leave the city till the excitement blows over. Hollister gets him a position with a Mr. White, Toledo millionaire, as private secretary. When the New York job blows over, Wilson returns. While at the White home, he has noticed that Mr. White's New York representative resembles him and plans to cash a check on White's account, disguising himself as Mr. Hart, the New York representative. This he does by forging a check for $35,000 instead of $35.00, his salary. He divides the profits with his co-conspirator, Hollister. The bank calls to its assistance a celebrated lawyer, Edward Knowlton, who, desiring to engage a companion for his elderly sister, stops with his son, Frank, at the Hollister Agency. There the Knowltons meet Louise and offer her the position, but Wilson wants to keep her out of the situation so that, in her poverty and distress, she will accept Wilson's proposal of marriage. Unable to get Louise, Knowlton leaves orders to send someone. When Wilson learns that Knowlton has taken up the case, he says he must get in Knowlton's house as a servant of some kind to watch what clues Knowlton finds. He tells Hollister to send Louise, where she is installed in the house as companion. By her wonderful charm and sweetness, she captivates the entire family, including the son, Frank. Wilson soon finds a way to install himself as valet to Knowlton, just at the time when Knowlton's clues lead him to certain suspicions. As these suspicions point to him, he decides to put Knowlton out of the way. Knowlton and his son, Frank, after dinner, have a parley on the division of the Knowlton property. The will, as made, gives Frank the greater share of the property and Frank's sister the smaller part, whereas Frank believes his sister's share should be increased to equal his own. When the family has gone to bed, Wilson finds Knowlton alone in the library. Wilson strikes, there is a struggle, and he leaves Knowlton for dead, after having stolen and changed the will so that it goes back to the original unequal division of the estate. description: Laurie Phaï, former high-level athlete, embarks on intensive running following the tragic loss of her premature baby. Her participation in several trails places her on the path of Ludovic Collet, renowned trail speaker and trainer.

title: Ayiti Toma, au pays des vivants
description: Beyond the country that overcame slavery to become the first Black Republic, beyond the country that has survived numerous natural disasters and even humanitarian aid, lies Ayiti Toma, the 'country that is ours'. The documentary that bears this name aspires to present this lesser known, more inclusive Ayiti as it is retold and illuminated by the Ayitians themselves, be they intellectuals, politicians, practitioners of voodoo or young survivors from a hard-hit borough of Port-au-Prince. With the additional input of anthropologists, historians and aid workers (including Sean Penn), this documentary illustrates that the extraordinary culture of this 'magical people' must be taken into account if Ayiti Toma, the land of the living is to come into being.

title: Blade Runner 2099
description: Takes place fifty years after the events of "Blade Runner 2049."

title: Mencuri  Pacar CEO kakakku
description:
Demi membiayai pembedahan bapanya, Mu Qianyue menyamar sebagai anak sulung keluarga Gu untuk menggantikan Gu Qianqian yang melarikan diri daripada perkahwinan. Dia berkahwin dengan seorang lelaki yang diselubungi pelbagai khabar angin. Pada zahirnya, dia melakukannya demi sepuluh juta, tetapi tujuan sebenarnya adalah untuk menyelamatkan masa depan bapanya.
Di syarikat keluarga Gu, Mu Qianyue bijak menangani provokasi Yun Weiwei sambil merahsiakan identitinya. Yun Weiwei berulang kali memasang perangkap untuk membongkar penyamarannya, tetapi semuanya berjaya dipatahkan oleh Mu Qianyue. Apabila bapanya dihina dalam sebuah majlis, dia tampil mempertahankannya dan membongkar muslihat Yun Weiwei.
Akhirnya, suaminya mengetahui identiti sebenar Mu Qianyue, namun memilih untuk melindunginya. Segala kejahatan Yun Weiwei terbongkar sehingga dia disenaraihitamkan sepenuhnya. Dengan bantuan suaminya, Mu Qianyue membongkar konspirasi keluarga Gu, menemukan asal usul dirinya yang sebenar, dan bersama-sama melangkah ke masa depan.

title: Segitiga Cinta Mematikan (Sulih Suara)
description: Olivia dipaksa suaminya, Ryan, mengikuti liburan tukar pasangan. Ia dipasangkan dengan Jake, suami dari Mia, yang merupakan sahabat baiknya. Jake adalah pria memesona yang sulit ditebak, dan pantang menyerah, jauh berbeda dari suami membosankan yang selalu diceritakan Mia. Saat Ryan dan Jake mulai berebut perhatian Olivia, kecemburuan telah membuat Mia menunjukkan sosok aslinya. Olivia harus mengungkapan kebenaran di balik acara itu sebelum semuanya terlambat.

title: Guitar for Beginners
description:
Grasp the essentials needed to begin playing acoustic or electric guitar. You'll learn an easy approach to get you playing quickly, through a combination of exploring the instrument, performance technique, and basic music theory.
For students who have long thought about picking up the acoustic or electric guitar, this course will provide an easy-access foundation that will get you playing. When first learning guitar, it is important to have the material presented in stages, in an enjoyable way that allows you to grasp the basics of the instrument and music. The course begins simply with the parts of the guitar, the names of the strings, tuning, and technique—whether finger-style or pick. It then explores the basics of music theory with such topics as scales, triads, power chords, and fingering and shapes.
At the end of this course, students will understand the structure, parts, and accessories of the instrument, in addition to an understanding of its basic maintenance. Electric guitar players will learn the operation of their instrument along with basic options for amplification, effect pedals, and sounds. Students will also learn to develop correct technique and apply theory concepts to their playing. They will have the foundational knowledge necessary to pursue most intermediate guitar courses.

title: Learn Numbers for Kids
description:
Learn numbers easy and fast for kids
Is it time for your kid to learn numbers? Is your child finding it hard to work with numbers? Don’t worry we for the best ideas for you that will make it easy for your kid to learn numbers easily and very quickly. 
Numbers will form the basic foundation for your kid's learning process. These are the first steps towards academic learning and this foundation needs to be very strong if you want your kid to grasp the upcoming concepts quickly and very firmly. 
So how can you learn numbers easily and fast? Let’s talk in detail.
1. Casually repeat the numbers at home
The more the child hears it the more he/she will learn quickly. Make it a habit to sing or repeat the numbers casually around the house. Gradually the kid will start to grasp the tune and will start repeating the numbers. So, in this way, the numbers will become a part of his/her memory without much effort. 
2. Use some books
You can use the kid's book to make your kid familiar with the numbers. How they look, and how they are pronounced. Kids get very attracted to colors and cartoons so choose a book that they like and enjoy. The more they enjoy reading the book, the quicker they will learn. 
3. Use toys 
There are many numbers of toys available, like blocks. They are very helpful for the kids in fast learning. The kid will learn while he is playing, and this is by far the best method to teach the kids. 
4. Use videos
There are many YouTube videos that teach the kids numbers. They are made for toddlers and are very attractive to the kids. Watching them repeatedly will help the kids learn the numbers easily and fast. So, use some good YouTube videos. 
You can adopt any of the ways that your child responds the best too. Give your child the time to learn and you will see a very good result.

title: "Africa's Epic Wonders: Journey Through Its Most Stunning Places!" | 4K Video
description: Embark on an unforgettable journey through "Africa's Majestic Landscapes: A Geographical Odyssey"! This stunning TV documentary takes you across the continent’s most awe-inspiring natural wonders, from the life-giving Nile River to the snow-capped summit of Mount Kilimanjaro, the thundering Victoria Falls, and the wildlife-rich Ngorongoro Crater. Witness the Great Migration in the Maasai Mara and Serengeti, explore the vast Sahara Desert, glide through the Okavango Delta’s waterways, and stand atop Cape Town’s iconic Table Mountain. With breathtaking aerial visuals, captivating narration, and a powerful orchestral score infused with African rhythms, this documentary unveils the secrets of Africa’s diverse landscapes, their cultural significance, and the challenges they face in a changing world. Perfect for nature lovers, adventure seekers, and anyone fascinated by the beauty and resilience of our planet! Highlights: The Nile’s 6,650km journey sustaining ancient and modern civilizations Kilimanjaro’s sacred slopes and disappearing glaciers The Great Migration’s epic struggle for survival Victoria Falls’ raw power and misty rainbows The Sahara’s ancient secrets and resilient nomads Okavango Delta’s wildlife paradise Table Mountain’s biodiversity and timeless allure Subscribe for more epic nature documentaries and hit the bell to never miss an adventure! Share your favorite African landscape in the comments below! #Africa #NatureDocumentary #Geography #Wildlife #Travel #Adventure

description: Five childhood friends, who all live in the same Ssangmundong neighborhood of Seoul in 1988, lean on each other to survive their challenging teen years and set a path for their futures.

title: Racun Cinta Sang Mafia (Sulih Suara)
description: Di hari pernikahan saudari tirinya, Victoria, Lily Watson—perawat berusia 25 tahun—dipaksa membuat kesepakatan mematikan. Victoria seharusnya menikah dengan Dominic Castellano, raja mafia kejam yang dikabarkan membunuh istri pertamanya. Namun saat Victoria kabur, anak buah Dominic mengancam keluarga Lily. Demi melindungi mereka, Lily menggantikan Victoria di altar dan menjadi pengantin pria yang ia takutkan sebagai pembunuh.

title: (Sulih suara) Kekayaannya Tak Terbatas
description: (Sulih suara) Kekayaannya Tak Terbatas

title: Penyesalan Terakhir Sang Pangeran (Sulih Suara)
description: Setelah pesta topeng, Pangeran Kit salah mengenali saudari tiri Ella sebagai dirinya, lalu menyamar jadi pengawal di keluarga Ella sambil mengabaikan dan menyakitinya. Ella yang patah hati memilih menikahi Pangeran Buas terkutuk. Usai mengorbankan sisa usianya demi kebenaran, Kit meminta Ella pergi dengannya di hari pernikahan demi menebus dosa di tujuh hari terakhir hidupnya. Pada akhirnya, Kit dimaafkan dan selamat, sementara Ella kembali ke Pangeran Buas yang dicintainya.

title: Cinta Terlarang Ayah Mafiaku
description: Setelah kematian orang tuanya, Sienna terpaksa menerima saudara laki-laki ayah tirinya—Kian Voss, seorang pedagang senjata yang kejam—sebagai walinya. Karena putus asa ingin melarikan diri, ia mengikuti pria itu ke sebuah klub SM rahasia, namun akhirnya ia justru dibawa ke ruangan pribadi Kian dengan wajah tertutup topeng. Rencananya untuk membongkar kedok pria itu malah berubah menjadi hasrat berbahaya yang membuat ketagihan...

title: [Dijuluki]Cinta di Malam Hujan
description: Untuk menemukan bukti pelecehan yang dilakukan pacarnya dan menghapus rasa malu yang dialami pacarnya, dia berpura-pura menjadi pelatih pribadi dan mendekati istri pria tersebut. Namun tak disangka, semua ini ternyata jebakan yang sengaja dipasang oleh pria itu dan kekasihnya

title: Aku Menyesal Mencintaimu
description: Lily Taylor yang gemuk selalu dihina oleh teman-teman sekolah, bahkan pria idolanya, Lucas Reed. Lily Taylor pun melupakannya dan akhirnya bertemu Sebastian. Kisah cinta mereka pun dimulai.

title: Pergi Tanpa Menoleh
description: | Lin Yiran dan Fu Yanchen menikah lima tahun. Tetapi di malam ulang tahunnya ini, ia menunggu sampai restoran tutup, Fu Yanchen tidak datang menemani merayakan ulang tahun. Rupanya cahaya bulannya kembali ke negeri, ia meninggalkan istri sendiri, pergi menjemput cahaya bulan. Fu Yanchen sepenuhnya mengabaikan perasaan istri, membawa cahaya bulan kembali ke vilanya. Mengira istri sopan dan dewasa, seharusnya tidak marah. Tidak tahu, dalam lima tahun ini, berkali-kali diabaika

title: Dia Bukan Elise yang Kau Cintai
description: Clyde dan Elise, sepasang kekasih masa kecil berencana saling menikah setelah 20 tahun terpisah. Clyde datang ke tempat yang telah dijanjikan untuk bertemu dengan Elise. Akibat kesalahpahaman, Clyde mengira sahabat Elise sebagai Elise dan sesuai janji mereka, akan saling menikah. Sementara Elise yang diterima bekerja sebagai sekretaris Clyde, harus menekan rasa cintanya pada bosnya demi persahabatan tanpa menyadari bahwa bosnya adalah cintanya yang telah lama hilang.

title: Dari Korban Menjadi Ancaman
description: Dikhianati oleh istrinya sendiri dan dijebak oleh sebuah sindikat kriminal, Frank, seorang instruktur militer yang telah banyak menerima penghargaan pun kehilangan segalanya. Setelah bertahun-tahun menjalani latihan keras selama berada di balik jeruji besi, Frank berhasil menyusup ke dalam sebuah keluarga mafia yang sangat berpengaruh. Perlahan, dia mendapatkan kepercayaan mereka dan terus naik dalam hierarki organisasi tersebut. Namun, keinginannya untuk membalas dendam pribadi lambat laun berubah menjadi sebuah misi yang jauh lebih besar, yaitu menghancurkan dunia mafia itu dari dalam.

title: (Sulih suara) Taklukkan Pahlawan Untuk Bangkit
description: (Sulih suara) Taklukkan Pahlawan Untuk Bangkit

title: [Dubbing]Cinta Tak Lekang Oleh Waktu
description: Di masa modern, Sherly mengadopsi si kembar succubus Arven dan Aster. Saat identitas mereka terbongkar, keduanya harus kembali ke Alam Iblis meski berat meninggalkan Sherly. Setelah konspirasi, pengorbanan, dan hilang ingatan memisahkan mereka, takdir mempertemukan mereka kembali dan menyatukan cinta yang tak lekang oleh waktu.

title: (Sulih suara) Penyamaran Berbuah Manis
description: (Sulih suara) Penyamaran Berbuah Manis

title: Tidur dengan Ayah Sahabatku (Sulih Suara)
description: Setelah memergoki tunangannya selingkuh, Mia mabuk dan tidur dengan Damien, triliuner misterius. Keesokan harinya, dia baru tahu Damien adalah ayah sang pengantin wanita. Terpaksa menyembunyikan hubungan terlarang mereka, Mia harus menghadapi mantan yang cemburu dan sabotase yang mengancam pernikahan.

title: Menikah lagi dengan Ketua Direksi(Dubbing)
description: Setelah Susi Darma bercerai dan anaknya hilang, dia pun membesarkan putranya seorang diri. Demi menyelamatkan putranya dan mendonorkan ginjal, putranya memilih ibunya dan bercerai. Di sisi lain, Susi Darma menolong seorang wanita dan malah dijodohkan dengan Pak Jonan, orang terkaya. Kemudian, mendapati wanita tersebut adalah putrinya yang lama menghilang. Akhirnya, mereka sekeluarga pun berkumpul kembali.

title: Kegilaanku Hanya untukmu
description: Mia Wilo dari kecil sudah kehilangan orang tuanya. Biar bisa hidup mandiri, dia menjual lukisan buat cari uang. Suatu hari, dia nggak sengaja masuk ke rumah pria kaya terkenal di Kota Yunda dan ketemu Juno Jaya, yang lagi kena masalah. Setelah kejadian konyol itu, Mia kabur. Tapi sebulan kemudian, dia dikonfirmasi positif hamil. Dia nggak tahu di ujung kota lain, Juno mencarinya sampai hampir gila.

title: Cinta dan Dominasi
description: Lima tahun lalu, Nabila menikah ke Keluarga Liman. Dia nggak peduli suaminya, Fikri yang bajingan dan jarang pulang. Dia hanya mengincar kekayaan. Siapa sangka, Fikri mendadak bangkrut dan lumpuh. Nabila malah nggak tinggalkan dia karena Nabila melihat potensi pada diri Fikri dan mau andalkan dia untuk kembali ke kehidupan orang kaya...

title: Doktor Dari Dunia Lain
description: Doktor Dari Dunia Lain

title: (Sulih suara) Panggilan dari Seberang Cermin
description: (Sulih suara) Panggilan dari Seberang Cermin

title: Adik Kesayangan tiga kakak
description: Di kehidupan sebelumnya, Arman membantu tiga kakak perempuan meraih kesuksesan. Setelah ia berhasil meraih gelar juara ujian kekaisaran lewat usahanya sendiri, ketiga kakaknya malah berniat menguliti wajahnya. Semua itu demi adik lelaki mereka, Andra, agar menggantikannya sebagai juara. Setelah reinkarnasi, takdir apa yang menantinya?

title: Selirku Jangan Kabur
description: Gadis itu adalah anak yang tidak dicintai dalam keluarga. Dia pintar dan cantik, tetapi karena dia dianiaya, dia hanya bisa berpura-pura bodoh untuk menghindari sorotan. Karena kakaknya sudah tidak perawan lagi, dia dipaksa menggantikan posisi gadis itu dan berhubungan seks dengan pangeran selama satu malam. Kemudian, gadis itu melarikan diri dari rumah bersama ibunya dan mengetahui bahwa dia hamil. Lima tahun kemudian, dia melahirkan sepasang anak kembar. Tapi yang tidak dia duga adalah bahwa pria dari tahun itu tampaknya telah menemukan kebenaran dan datang mencarinya...

title: Ibu Agen Rahasia [Indonesian]
description: Ibu yang sehari-hari jual daging, sebenarnya pendiri agen rahasia kerajaan

title: Pewaris Miskin Menaklukkan Kaisar
description: | Mahasiswa kedokteran Li Miao melintas ke zaman kuno, menjadi putra tertua keluarga Li di Jinling. Menghadapi keluarga Li yang sudah miskin dan secarik kertas perjanjian pernikahan dengan maharani dinasti ini. Li Miao mengira akan mengalami nasib seperti tokoh utama lain, memainkan drama miskin jangan hina remaja, membatalkan pertunangan dan membalas maharani. Namun menghadapi inspeksi rahasia maharani, Li Miao tanpa tahu identitasnya menunjukkan bakat pada lawannya. Maharan

title: Cinta yang Menikam
description: Setelah dihianati dan dibunuh di tanah airnya, Avina terlahir kembali. Di kehidupan sebelumnya, dia diperkosa karena menolak menari dan dijadikan budak tentara. Kini, dia memilih jalan berbeda, bersolek dan menari di hadapan musuh untuk bertahan hidup. Dengan kepintaran dan tipu daya, dia menyusun balas dendam. Raka, sang paduka yang awalnya curiga, justru jatuh hati. Namun, saat cinta dan tipu muslihat saling bertarung, siapa yang akan menang?

title: Masa Lalu yang Tidak Akan Terulang
description: Kehidupan sebelumnya, Nisa sesuai keinginannya menikah dengan Pangeran Keempat yang sangat luar biasa, Baim, dengan hati yang tulus setelah mendapat titah dari Kaisar. Awalnya, dia berpikir mereka berdua akan menua dengan bahagia, tetapi tidak tahunya Baim sudah memiliki pujaan hati. Karena alasan itu pula, Nisa ditelantarkan, disiksa, hingga akhirnya meninggal. Setelah terlahir kembali, Nisa pun bersumpah tidak akan mengulang kesalahan yang sama lagi!

title: [Dubbing]Bercerai dengan Suami Psikopat
description: Zoe Parker akhirnya menerima pengajuan perceraian suaminya setelah diceraikan 99 kali. Di saat Zoe hendak setuju dan memberi kebebasan kepada suaminya, dia baru tahu ternyata suaminya juga mencintainya. Lantas mengapa suaminya mengajukan perceraian hingga 99 kali kepadanya?

title: Kutemukan Lagi Cinta Yang Hilang
description: Tujuh tahun lalu, akibat dibius, Carly dan Marcus bercinta. Percintaan satu malam itu membuat Carly hamil dan melahirkan seorang putra. Namun akibat satu dan lain hal keduanya terpisah tanpa Marcus tahu Carly telah melahirkan seorang putra untuknya. Kini tujuh tahun kemudian, takdir kembali mempertemukan mereka. Akankah pertemuan kali ini akan menautkan hati keduanya?

title: Takkan Lagi Cinta Dikejar
description: Tak ingin dipaksa menikah dengan CEO miliarder Frank Reed, Kate Smith melarikan diri dari altar. Dalam pelariannya, Kate meminta bantuan seorang pria yang bersedia membantunya asalkan Kate mau menikah dengannya. Tanpa disadari Kate, pria yang dimintai bantuan ternyata adalah calon suami yang dihindarinya, Frank Reed. Setelah akhirnya kebohongan terungkap, akankah Kate mau memaafkan Frank?

title: Pergi Tanpa Menoleh (Sulih Suara)
description: Demi membalas budi, Fandy menandatangani kontrak lima tahun dengan ibu Ruth untuk menemani dan merawatnya agar bisa bangkit dari keterpurukan akibat patah hati. Selama lima tahun, Fandy diam-diam memberikan segalanya, tapi pada akhirnya, dia hanyalah pengganti Mike, sosok yang selalu ada di hati Ruth.Saat kontrak berakhir dan Mike kembali dari luar negeri, Fandy memilih untuk pergi dan mengajukan perceraian…

title: Saat Kau Pergi, Aku Baru Tahu (Sulih Suara)
description: Nicole diangkat sebagai anak oleh Damian saat dia berusia tujuh tahun, dan dia pun jatuh cinta pada pria yang dia panggil paman ini tanpa bisa dihindari. Tetapi Damian merasa dirinya sepuluh tahun lebih tua darinya, dan memutuskan untuk menggunakan cara berpacaran dengan wanita lain untuk mengakhiri angan-angan Nicole yang tidak realistis itu, tetapi detak jantungnya tidak bisa menipunya sendiri. Nicole yang patah hati memutuskan untuk meninggalkan Damian...

title: Ketika Hati Memilih Pergi (Sulih Suara)
description: Asya dan Dhevan telah menikah secara diam-diam selama empat tahun. Di siang hari, dia adalah bawahan Dhevan yang paling cakap, dan di malam hari, dia adalah istrinya yang sangat dicintai. Dia selalu berpikir bahwa hubungan mereka tidak akan berubah, tetapi di bawah bimbingan ibu mertuanya, Asya secara bertahap menyadari bahwa Dhevan perlahan-lahan melewati batas dengan Kezia yang muda dan ceria. Asya memutuskan untuk bercerai, dan mulai menata kembali masa depannya...

title: Ciumanmu Mengubah Duniaku (Sulih Suara)
description: Sakit hati karena dikhianati oleh pacar dan sahabatnya sendiri, Gabrielle, seorang model, mengacaukan pesta pertunangan mereka. Takdir mempertemukan Gabrielle dengan Kyle, seorang CEO tampan, dan keduanya jatuh cinta, yang memicu serangkai kejadian yang mengubah dunia mereka berdua.

title: When Rain Left Summer
description: Forced to marry wealthy Dirga for her mother’s ambition, Kirana leaves Raindra behind. Beneath luxury, she endures abuse and a deadly illness. When true love returns, she has little time left to be happy

title: Second Account (Microdrama)
description: When Rini discovers her deceased sister's secret online persona as a sexy cosplay ASMR performer, she teams up with her sister's loyal fans to uncover the truth behind her death - but the deeper she digs, the more dangerous the truth becomes.

title: Game On, Girl! (Microdrama)
description: It's a story about the passion and struggle of a young woman named Angel in exploring the realities of life. She embarks on a journey full of twists and turns as she becomes twenty years old. Angel is searching for what she wants and what she needs, as well as finding what future lies for her in the challenging 21st century.

title: Permainan Rahasia Dua Putraku
description: Saat melahirkan dikhianati kakak dan tunangan, dia bawa anak “satu-satunya yang hidup” kabur ke luar negeri. Lima tahun kembali balas dendam, eh tau-tahu anaknya tak mati, dulu salah tidur dengan orang! Dan dua anak kembarnya, diam-diam tukar identitas, bantu Mama cari ayah kandung yang benar!

title: Cinta Gagal Paham
description:
Sandra dan Gaby merasa telah memenangkan segalanya: menikah dengan keluarga William yang kaya raya, mendapatkan cinta, kemewahan, dan status sosial. Namun, di balik pernikahan mewah dan senyum sempurna, tersembunyi kebenaran pahit—mereka hanyalah pelarian, pengisi kekosongan hati para pewaris yang masih terobsesi pada masa lalu.
Terjebak dalam dunia penuh aturan ketat, intrik keluarga, dan permainan terselubung, Sandra dan Gaby harus memainkan peran mereka dengan sempurna. Namun, ketika kabar beredar bahwa ""Lily""—cinta sejati yang mereka gantikan—akan kembali, kehidupan yang mereka bangun perlahan runtuh. Tekanan semakin memuncak saat Novi, saudara angkat keluarga yang licik, terus merendahkan mereka, sementara perasaan terlarang terhadap suami mereka sendiri mulai tumbuh.
Di antara pesta mewah dan pertemuan rahasia, kedua penipu ini harus memutuskan: Apakah mereka hanya pion dalam permainan warisan dan balas dendam, atau bisa mereka melawan dan memperjuangkan kebahagiaan mereka sendiri?

title: Mimpi Buruk Keluarga Jutawan
description: Ayudia, ilmuwan hebat dari 1965, hidup kembali di tubuh remaja 18 tahun. Dengan jiwa Nyonya besar, ia mengacak-acak dunia keluarga Mahesa: menertibkan Denise, membuka mata Rafael, mendidik para pembully—sambil tetap memenangkan kontes nyanyi dan menyelamatkan bumi dari ancaman puing antariksa.

title: Wistoria: Wand and Sword
description: A teen without magical powers enrolls in a magic academy. He can't use a wand, but his skill with a sword fuels his drive to keep a promise to a friend.

title: My Lethal Man
description: Because of an unexpected kidnapping case, Shen Man Ning discovers Zhuang Xin Yan. After Zhuang Xin Yan dies, the powerful and mysterious Yan Xing Cheng forces Shen Man Ning to start her "second life" as his fiancee. As they overcome adversities and difficulties together, the two go from being utterly hostile to one another to slowly joining hands, learning to love and rely on each other. Together they discover the truth of the unsolved case from 17 years ago.

title: I nostri
description: "I Nostri" describes the experience of a group of university students - four males and four females - who are involved in a research project on the hidden world of the religious communities that inhabit their city (Bologna, Italy). A world that is often invisible and largely made up of immigrants from all over the world, who represent a lively cross-section of the Italy of today, much closer and more present than we might imagine (Bologna is home to more than 60,000 foreigners of 149 nationalities, one of the highest figures in Italy). The documentary follows the discussions of the group and the meetings of the young people with the communities and their spiritual guides, in the most ordinary places of worship and in others that are more hidden and improbable (garages, industrial warehouses, hotels). The different souls of the group are held together by a young priest whose role is revealed only at the end of the documentary. "I Nostri" - "Our People". A provocative title to affirm that the "other" is first and foremost a person, with a story and dignity that are no different from our own. We are all "our people".

title: Переродившаяся Луной сломленного Короля ликанов
description: Дакоте Бладвин, с рождения носящей серебряный полумесяц Богини Луны, было предначертано величие. Но вместо этого ее пара, Аларик Титан, убил ее спустя восемь лет, поскольку она оставалась бесплодной. Переродившись в свою 22-ю Ночь Выбора и полностью сохранив воспоминания, она берет знак Малакая Бладмуна. Устрашающий Король ликанов теряет контроль над разумом и своим волком, но Дакота подозревает, что его отравили. Ее божественная метка обжигает при каждой лжи, ведя ее к предателю. Чтобы выжить, она должна спасти свою истинную пару и разоблачить тех, кто жаждет их смерти.

title: Vagabundo y millonario
description: After failing to locate a kidnapped millionaire, the chief of police fools an identical-looking tourist to pose as the kidnapped gentleman to fool the criminals into letting him loose.

title: El Tiempo y el Silencio
description: A man gives a workshop on In Search of Lost Time, by Marcel Proust. Under the excess of the project, failure is on the horizon. However, after meeting a woman, he decides to share his time with her between silence and the passing of days.

title: Zamora: Tierra y hombres libres
description: Setting: Venezuela, in the second half of the nineteenth century. Disputes between Liberals and Conservatives marked the political agenda. Social inequalities inherited from colonial times have kept peasants and slaves under the yoke of the Oligarchy. Ezequiel Zamora, mobilized by the profound ideals of freedom, leads a struggle trying to erase the gap between the opulence of the rich and the misery of the poor, and fair allocation of land.

title: Una última y nos vamos
description: A Marichi group will leave their hometown for the first time to perform at a national competition in Mexico City. After being selected, this band of seven set out to find an eighth member to be able to compete. They decide to recruit Martin, the son of one of the members who happens to be in a rock band. The eight men have to endure many challenges in which their brotherhood is put to the test. What seems to be the opportunity of a lifetime, might soon become the beginning of the end for the band.

title: Dos Mujeres y una Vaca
description: We all have something to hide.

title: Sra. Detective y Sr. Ladrón
description: Después de 15 años saltan chispas cuando Isabel y Ari se reencuentran y se vuelven amantes apasionados. Ella es una detective que intenta hacer carrera atrapando a un misterioso ladrón maestro. A medida que Ari la ayuda en su investigación y su romance se vuelve más apasionado, ¿se dará cuenta de que su amante es el criminal que está buscando?

title: La bella Ceci y el imprudente
description: Un hombre rico y un hombre pobre intercambian roles y encuentran el verdadero sentido de sus vidas, y del amor.

title: The Fast and the Furious: Tokyo Drift
description: A teenager becomes a major competitor in the world of drift racing after moving in with his father in Tokyo to avoid a jail sentence in America.

title: The Labyrinth of Grisaia: The Cocoon of Caprice 0 [Indonesian]
description: Having attended Mihama Academy for about a year, Yuuji Kazami has seemingly found his place within the school, but he suddenly decides to pursue a promotion in CIRS. After consulting JB about his intentions, they both thoroughly examine Yuuji's documents and dissect the events of his upbringing to determine if the job is fit for him. Meanwhile, unbeknownst to the two, the girls of Mihama uncover some torn documents in Yuuji's room. After restoring the papers, they discover the story that has formed, or perhaps broken, Yuuji into the man he is today. However, what was thought to be history has haunted him to the present, and the chains of the past begin to drag him back into the darkness.

title: A Light Sleep [Indonesian]
description:
Sixteen-year-old Yeo Lin used to have a boyfriend and normal life, but everything changed when she lost both her parents two years ago. To support her siblings, she sells her body. Quietly bearing wounds and responsibilities beyond her age, she faces the cruel trials of love, friendship, and premature adulthood, and she does it all in seeming detachment. Always tired, Yeo Lin suffers from chronic insomnia and relies on medication to sleep. For Yeo Lin, sleep is an escape that she wakes from too soon.

Directed by Lim Seong-chan, the 2008 indie drama A Light Sleep sensitively depicts the ordeals faced by an insomniac high school girl forced to grow up too soon. Teenaged newcomer Choi Ah-jin delivers a mature and compelling performance in the leading role. The film co-stars Yoon Chan and Hong Ah-reum

title: When C Goes with G7
description: When a heartbroken film school graduate, an unemployed UC Berkeley MBA graduate and a junior high school student converge at the music instruments store of an aspiring musician, quirky thoughts on everything from work and education to love and life emerge against a truly catchy soundtrack. Relationships end and hopes are occasionally dashed in this episodic drama, but few could complain that this isn't a thoughtful attempt to capture the sentiments of growing up in Hong Kong as we know it today.

title: Blades of the Guardians
description: Dao Ma, a bounty hunter, takes a job to protect a man on the long road to the city of Chang'an. However, he discovers the person he is protecting is the empire's most wanted bounty, Zhi Shi Lang. Now, every greedy faction is after them.

title: My Life on the Supervillain D-list
description: 'This is Spinal Tap' meets the comic book world of 'The Dark Knight'. This comedy mockumentary features comic book villains living in a realistic world. As we follow the ridiculous, daily activities of this group of flawed villains, through the eyes of a documentary camera crew, we see them struggle to live normal lives. A trip to the grocery store could suddenly turn into a brawl for a villain if he runs into the wrong hero. What if he was just running out to get milk? Villains have errand that they need to do, just like the rest of us. The villains' problems are offset by looking at equally flawed, pretentious superheroes. We see how society treats this group as infallible based on the preconceived notions of heroes, even though they are anything but perfect. A revered superhero can cause massive property damage and hurt innocent bystanders regularly, but he is easily forgiven as long as he beats the perceived threat to the city. Yet the villains are always reviled. Will they ever get ahead and overcome their issues?

title: E allora mambo!
description: Stefano is turning thirty in a small town in Romagna. He has a boring job, a family he loves, lots of debts and he always thinks about the good old days he spent studying in Bologna with his friend Mauro, now a lawyer. Because of an error of the bank, he suddenly receives 6 billions lire (3 millions USD) and he decides to change his life... turning back time: he will pretend to have a new job in Bologna but he will go to town every day to live the life of a grown-up student. title: O Ajustador
description: Após a morte de sua irmã por lhe ter sido rejeitado o plano de saúde, Matteo Leone — um homem arrasado — decide fazer justiça com as próprias mãos, assassinando o CEO da seguradora. Mas sua motivação vai além da vingança: seu objetivo maior é expor as empresas corruptas de seguros de saúde que exploram injustamente os clientes mais vulneráveis. Matteo mantém-se sempre um passo à frente da polícia, deixando pistas pelo caminho para transmitir sua mensagem. Logo, ele se torna um herói para aqueles que os CEOs sem escrúpulos acreditavam poder silenciar.

title: O valtos
description: As the ruthless founders of a dummy company crash-land on a swampland with millions in cash, their only chance to escape abroad lies in the islet's four inhabitants. But greed threatens their plan. Is there an escape from the swamp?

title: 'O re
description: One of the key factors in Italian unification was the overthrow in 1860 of Francesco, the King of Naples and the two Sicilies, who went into elegant but impoverished exile in Rome with his Queen, Maria Sofia. This seriocomic drama follows the deposed royals as they adapt to their new lives. The former king has recognized the political finality of his deposition, but his queen has taken to traveling in men's clothing all over Italy trying to foment an uprising to restore them to the throne. She is also frantic to have a baby, an heir, but the king has become celibate as a kind of homage to his beloved mother; he spends all his time lobbying the Vatican to get her declared a saint.

title: O Erótico Virgem
description: Virgin boy has no success with sex. But his parents have to travel to Europe and leave their spoilt and childish son in the care of a friendly couple, who have a beautiful daughter and a maid who is only too interested in the boy's sexual situation.

title: Desculpe o Transtorno
description: Eduardo discovers he has a split personality: a buttoned-up São Paulo executive and beach-loving weekend playboy in Rio de Janeiro called Duca. Unconsciously, he becomes entangled with a woman although he's already engaged to another.

title: H.P. Lovecraft's Witch House
description: Graduate student Alice Gilman is running from an abusive past. She seeks refuge in the infamous Hannah house; a historic home with an ominous past. Determined to prove the possibility of alternate dimensions, she unknowingly unlocks a gateway to unimaginable horror. Facing a series of bizarre and violent events, Alice is plagued by nightmarish dreams of these evil entities. Trapped between the 4th dimension and reality, the diabolical truth is revealed as Alice fights for her sanity and her very soul. Based on the H.P. Lovecraft's short story The Dreams in the Witch House, WITCH HOUSE blurs the boundaries between reality,dreams...and the beyond.

title: Miss Q&A Jomaima, bumoses tungkol sa edukasyon sa Pinas
description:
Sabi nila, may darating na someone, someday, 'yung kapag nakita mo siya parang laging may background music ang paligid. Kapit lang, dahil minsan dumarating 'yan nang biglaan. Habang hinihintay ang pagdating ng pag-ibig, heto na si Mr. Randomantic James Reid, handang magpakilig!

Lahat sa mundo may halaga, mula sa mga kulisap hanggang bulaklak sa hardin at mga puno (please huwag naman natin silang putulin). Sa Miss Q and A, boses ng mga kandidata ay may halaga at aral na puwedeng pulutin.

Huwag 'inaancha' ang mga kandidata dahil hindi sila basta-basta. May maipagmamalaking talento, talino at puso sina Summer Rejane Corpuz, Wilson The Buss, at Jomaima Johnson na nagpagalingan sa talakan.

Hot na hot talaga ang puksaan with special guest hurado Marina Summers. Present pa rin si Nicole Cordoves, with Ralph de Leon. Sina Wilson The Buss at Jomaima ang umabante sa Wit Lang. Parehobg bumoses, pero sa korona, isa lang ang sumakses! Si Jomaima ang wagi bilang Miss Q&A Reyna Talakers of the day.

Enjoy the feels, pero make sure na hindi mo mami-miss ang kulitan sa Laro Laro Pick kung saan bumida ang mga taga-Tonsuya, Malabon sa game arena.

Pagdating ng You Gotta Lyric round, si Dalag ang only player na naka-survive! Baka pampaalis ng kaba, nakipa-playtime si Dalag sa mga trip ni Vice Ganda hanggang sa Li-Pot offer na P35,000 ay kanyang tinanggap.

title: River Joseph, hurado sa Miss Q and A!
description:
Good music ang hatid ng “Tawag Ng Tanghalan” male champions na sina JM Yosures, Reiven Umali, JM Dela Cerna, Christian Tibayan, at Yannie Paul Basical. Pinagsama-sama ng limang powerhouse singers ang kanilang winning voices sa isang performance na perfect pampagaan ng mood bago sumabak sa weekend.

Nagbabalik sa "It's Showtime" for a second chance sa Miss Q&A Resbakulawan sina Nadie Marie Fernandez, Miukie, at Belle Tinkerbell.

Tumatak si Nadie dahil sa tawa niyang kakaiba. Natandaan naman ni Vice Ganda ang unique na pangalang Miukie. But arguably the most remarkable of the three, si Belle, na binansagang 'Sofronia Vasquez' ni Meme. Siya 'yung kandidata na sa pagpindot ay nahuli pero sa talak ang daming sinasabi. Hirit niya, baka pinabalik siya dahil awa, pero itinanggi 'yan ni Vice Ganda. Sabi ni Meme, nabitin daw ang lahat sa talak noon ni Belle.

Pagkatapos ng Wit Lang, ang Top 2 na sina Nadie at Belle ang nag-face off sa Beklamation kung saan mayroon silang tatlumpung segundo para sagutin ang tanong tungkol sa epekto ng pagkawala ng taong minamahal. Naging emosyonal si Nadie na inalala ang nawalang pamangkin, at galing din sa puso ang chukchak ni Belle na nagpahayag naman ng pagmamahal sa ina.

Dumayo sa Laro Laro Pick game arena ang mga taga-Barangay Batis, San Juan City. Hindi pasyal ang sadya nila kundi mga challenges na pwedeng magdala sa kanila sa POT money.

Nakipagkuwentuhan ng hosts sa tricycle driver na si Viomar. Pero ang nagpakitang-gilas, walang iba kundi si Amy Perez, na daig pa ang tricycle driver sa kanyang knowledge. Ang mga pasikot-sikot na kalye sa Maynila, kabisado ni Tyang!

Si Edwin ang nakarating sa Jackpot Round. Bago pa man ihain ang Li-Pot offer, buo na ang loob niyang ilaban ang ₱400,000 POT question anuman ang ialok sa kanya.

title: W starym dworku czyli niepodleglosc trójkatów
description: In a country house at the turn of a century live a family of eccentrics. Middle-aged Anastasia, the beautiful mistress of the manor, enjoys the amorous attentions of her sensitive artist stepson Jezory so openly that her old husband Dyapanazego takes out his shotgun and shoots her. The rest of the family accepts her end as a matter-of-fact, and soon - her return as a voyeuristic ghost who interferes with their love lives. She has a posthumous son Tadeusz, "born" by clambering out of the tree trunk. She seduces him too, and drives other men so crazy that they kill her a couple of times.

title: W. Somerset Maugham's of Human Bondage
description: A medical student becomes obsessed with his faithless lover.

headers.User-Agent: com.community.oneroom/50020120 (Linux; U; Android 13; en_US; 22101316G; Build/TQ2A.230405.003; Cronet/135.0.7012.3)

title: Opening Bell w/ Maria Bartiromo
description: Analysis of the day's business news and its impact on the markets.

title: Fox Report w/ Shepard Smith
description: National and world news on Fox News Channel.

title: Rodziców nie ma w domu
description: Ten-year-old Zosia dreams of having siblings. Parents are too busy pursuing their careers though. The girl spends her free time mostly with her grandfather. Unexpectedly, a new tenant appears at the house - Agnieszka, a psychology student, and the family's life changes with her.

title: W. Kamau Bell: Private School Negro
description: Activist and comedian W. Kamau Bell muses on parenting in the Trump era, "free speech" dustups, woke children's TV and his fear of going off the grid.

headers.User-Agent: com.community.oneroom/50020120 (Linux; U; Android 13; en_US; 22101316G; Build/TQ2A.230405.003; Cronet/135.0.7012.3)

title: Rojo y miel
description: tells the story of Claudia Bernard and Rodrigo Carvajal she was a young university student used to life in Santiago and Rodrigo is the foreman of the farm that belonged to her mother.

title: Hermanos y detectives
description: Franco Montero, an administrative detective, gets the unexpected obligation of the custody of his half-brother, Lorenzo Montero, who has an IQ of 200, and changes the way of life and work of the detective.

title: Felipe y Letizia
description: This dramatization chronicles the romance between Prince Felipe of Spain and journalist Letizia Ortiz as they face opposition to their marriage.

title: El cielo y tu
description: Father Mauro, a Catholic priest, loses his memory and ends in a hippie commune, where he falls in love with young Susana and gets her pregnant.

title: Caprichosa y millonaria
description: The father of a rich girl sends an administrator to control his waste. A great comedy by Enrique Santos Discépolo.

title: Ati y Mindiwa
description: Two sisters Ati and Mindhiva; They are part of the Arhuaca tribe, a Colombian indigenous culture. Their dream is to continue with their university studies. They have no money and it is impossible for them to enter in to the National University... Nevertheless they won't give up the fight and theta will search into other forms of education. Will they be able to find the strenght to continue pursuing their dream? We will follow them into their adventure.

title: 7 pasos y medio
description: Fate has offered two childhood friends very different lives. The same fate unites them after several years, and gives them the opportunity to radically change their unhappy situations.

title: Aquí y Allá
description: "AQUÍ": Pedro returns home to a small mountain village in Guerrero, Mexico after years of working in the US. He finds his daughters older, and more distant than he imagined. His wife still has the same smile. Having saved some earnings from two trips to the US, he hopes to now finally make a better life with his family, and even to pursue his dreams on the side by starting a band: Copa Kings. He cherishes the everyday moments with his family. "ALLÁ": The villagers think this year's crop will be bountiful. There is also good work in a growing city an hour away. But the locals are wise to a life of insecurity, and their thoughts are often of family members or opportunities far away, north of the border. While working in the fields, Pedro meets and begins to mentor a teenager who dreams of the US. That place somehow always feels very present, practically knocking at the door. "Aquí y Allá" is a story about hope, and the memories and loss of what we leave behind.

title: Margarita y el lobo
description: A woman is granted a separation from her husband and through a flashback her various battles with life's wolves are recounted.

title: Dragon Ball Z [English]
description: With the help of the powerful Dragonballs, a team of fighters led by the saiyan warrior Goku defend the planet earth from extraterrestrial enemies.

title: 7 Demons
description: Isaac, a half-demon, tracks down the forces of wickedness and evil in a world where the rapture has already occurred. Hot on the trail of a demon called Moloch, Isaac finds that the demon and its human allies are closing in on an ancient book that could turn the tide of war in their favour. To avenge the murder of his father and protect what's left of the world, Isaac will get the book at any cost.

title: 7 Stones
description: Laura Brummels is determined to avenge the death of a young boy - a death she could have prevented, but didn't. It's placed her in a prison of guilt driven by her cooperation as a reporter with a political regime that's successfully corrupted her. Fallen from grace with the regime, Laura is sentenced to Aquila, where no one escapes and an annual monsoon floods the prison, eliminating everyone. And she discovers her chance to clear her conscience: One of the notorious guards is the young boy's killer. This is her chance to avenge the boy's death and relieve her guilt. But there's a surprise for her in the large cell where she's placed: another prisoner, Joseph, has survived the last flood and has been working to escape from Aquila before the next flood comes. He's devised a clever means of removing stones from the prison ceiling, but he can't do it alone. To succeed he must convince his new cell mate to abandon murder and choose to survive with him and escape.

title: 8 semanas
description: Behind the curtains of a stage musical, based in the songs of Raffaella Carrá, a group of human beings comes and goes The characters driving the story are funny and tragic: the neurotic stage director, the "diva-style" leading actor, the drunk acting coach, a dancer (and compulsive drama queen), two actress who hate each other on stage and in real life, a pathetic Don Juan and some other few who live in the crazy world of the movie. 8 weeks is the first Argentinean Musical Documentary, mixing comedy, fiction and mockumentary Every show mirrors what's left behind curtains and everything happening behind curtains could be a show as well. You shouldn't believe everything you see and, at the same time, all you see is true. 8 weeks is a movie shot during a season of a real Musical and takes shape as a movie when it makes "the idea of representation" the main topic of its own matter, exposing the delicate balance between reality and representation
